acceptancePolicy: Exact-data/document families are accepted by validated evidence-preserving template rule; scene-oriented names are source stimulus types and the output is a schematic, not photography.
systemicIssues: Previous renderer family names conflated stimulus type with rendering strategy; deterministic outputs are schematic evidence cards, not workplace photographs.
Exact-data families preserve source evidence through structured brief fields and current renderer hashes.
Scene-oriented deterministic records are retained only where the image is a structured stimulus; their abstraction level is documented rather than mislabeled as a photo.
